sn.choose: Sarudza chigadzirwa chaicho; mashoko anogona kusiyana pakati pezvinowanikwa izvi.
sn.missing: Hazvina kupihwa mumashoko echigadzirwa akaburitswa. Bvunza chitoro usati wabvuma mutengo.
sn.missingAllergens: Hazvina kupihwa. Usafungidzira kuti chigadzirwa hachina zvinokonzera allergy; bvunza chitoro.
sn.allergenCaution: Simbisa zviri palebhu uye zvaunoda pakudya nechitoro; kusanyorwa kwechinhu hakurevi kuti hachipo.
sn.next: Simbisa chigadzirwa chaicho nechitoro usati wabvuma mutengo.
sn.failed: Mashoko echigadzirwa haana kuwanikwa. Handisimbisi izvi; vhura mashoko echigadzirwa wobvunza chitoro.

nd.choose: Khetha umkhiqizo oqondileyo; imininingwane ingahluka phakathi kwalokhu.
nd.missing: Akubekwanga emininingwaneni yomkhiqizo eshicilelweyo. Buza isitolo ungakamukeli intengo.
nd.missingAllergens: Akubekwanga. Ungacabangi ukuthi umkhiqizo awulazo izithako ezibangela ukungezwani; buza isitolo.
nd.allergenCaution: Qinisekisa ilebula yamanje lezidingo zokudla lesitolo; ukungabhalwa kwesithako akutsho ukuthi asikho.
nd.next: Qinisekisa impahla eqondileyo lesitolo ungakamukeli intengo.
nd.failed: Imininingwane yomkhiqizo ayitholakalanga. Angiqinisekisi lokhu; vula imininingwane ubuze isitolo.
